method: Separate Codex inspection of original goals, actual outputs, full dispositions, allocation, research provenance, quality findings and canonical receipts. Not model self-approval, an external human panel or Phase 5 held-out evidence.

cases.assessment: One integrated 45-minute explain/work/independent changed-series-circuit task. Specific correct values and reasoning form the stopping criterion; later practice is unbooked and error-triggered. No ritual sequence or extra circuits after success.

The same goal with 480 rather than 120 available daily minutes still books one 45-minute integrated demonstration. No extra mandatory set or phase work. Stopping wording about correcting a failed idea remains a caveat; the actual completion criterion still requires the correctly solved/explained changed circuit.

Only one 30-minute four-part diagnostic is committed; specific failed-step correction is unbooked contingent work. No CREDITED disposition or verified mastery is inferred from confidence. Diagnostic attempts/errors can be recorded as evidence.
Explicit DEFERRED scope with the learner reason, no activities of any category, zero-minute strategy and zero executable Quests after canonical apply.

Current/potential-difference distinction and four conservation rules are explicitly derived, then two unseen mixed circuits require correct values with per-step reasoning. All three scope nodes survive; no timed-paper substitute. 150 minutes spans two distinct supported/independent contributions, with unbooked gap-triggered practice and honest arithmetic uncertainty.

Every answer could be wrong while that criterion is satisfied, so accepted independent application is not evidenced. All four scope dispositions/contributions survive; priority is explicitly prerequisite/integration value, not invented topic weights. Deeper variants, topic-specific volume and timed conditions are explicitly sacrificed. Capacity is not a promise of readiness.

A concrete CSV-reading/grouping/bad-row build precedes a changed-file run, with full four-node scope and no deadline. The changed-file run tests hidden assumptions rather than mere time spent. Reviewer repetition and unknown basic-Python/likely-effort warnings remain; the 30-minute build timebox is not evidence that its 70-minute likely task is complete.

One integrated labeled Bayes/base-rate/sensitivity worked example plus independent changed example, correct posteriors and explanation as criterion; actual confusion triggers unbooked correction. No current CREDITED readiness. Contingent-remediation sequencing warning remains; its future activation does not happen automatically.
